reason: First recording: the serving count per revision (servingPodsByRevision) over one Component at rest, every pod serving on one revision. It runs twice per Component on every coordination pass (the observation and the endpoint reading) and once per member on every canary dispatch. The count builds two maps keyed by revision and Instance over every pod, so its cost is per Instance: 94 allocations and 1.56 MB per call at 4,000 single pods, 42 and 381 KB at 1,000 single pods and at 1,725 gangs of two, 24 and 43 KB at 160 gangs of eight. The pods are the pass fixture's, built in memory; nothing is read.
